hassio_confirm.title: Memory Card
hassio_confirm.description: Add the sensors and the Roll a pick button from the {addon} app?

abort.already_configured: Memory Card is already set up.
abort.discovery_only: Memory Card sets itself up. In the Memory Card app's configuration, set Home Assistant sensors to "integration" and restart the app; Home Assistant then shows it as discovered.
abort.invalid_discovery: The Memory Card app announced itself without an address or token. Update the app.
abort.single_app: Memory Card is already set up for another Memory Card app. Remove it first to use this one.

roll_pick.name: Roll a pick
roll_pick.description: Picks a random owned game from a person's backlog, as "Pick for me" on the Backlog page does. Without filters it picks from their backlog.

person.name: Person
person.description: Whose backlog to pick from. Leave it out to roll for yourself; an automation must name someone.

play_status.name: Play statuses
play_status.description: Play status keys to pick from. Empty means every status that counts as backlog.

platform.name: Platforms
platform.description: Platform slugs, as each platform's form in Memory Card shows them.

device.name: Devices
device.description: Device slugs: copies on these devices, or with no device on a platform one of them plays.

min_local_players.name: Local players
min_local_players.description: At least this many players on the same screen.

max_hours_to_beat.name: Hours to beat
max_hours_to_beat.description: At most this many hours for the main story, as IGDB gives it. Games without a time are left out.

cannot_connect.message: Cannot reach the Memory Card app.

invalid_filters.message: Memory Card could not read these filters.

not_loaded.message: Memory Card is not set up.

person_required.message: Name a person to roll a pick for.

play_not_allowed.message: Memory Card does not keep play for this person.

not_your_roll.message: You can only roll a pick for yourself.

unknown_person.message: This person has no Home Assistant user.
